findings.message: service "db" uses named volume "backups", which is not declared under top-level volumes
findings.suggestion: Declare it (`volumes: {backups: {}}`), or use "./backups" if you meant a bind mount of a local directory.

findings.message: service "db" joins network "monitoring", which is not declared under top-level networks
findings.suggestion: Declare it (`networks: {monitoring: {}}`), or mark it `external: true` if it is created outside this project.
